About Me

I am a Logistics Management graduate from Politeknik APP Jakarta with a strong interest in logistics operations, supply chain management, distribution, warehousing, and customs-related processes. I hold a competency certificate from the Badan Nasional Sertifikasi Profesi (BNSP) in the Warehouse Supervisor qualification, supporting my knowledge of warehouse operations, inventory control, shipment coordination, team leadership, workplace data analysis, and occupational health and safety.

Through internship experience at PT Pertamina Patra Niaga in Supply & Distribution and PT Monang Sianipar Abadi (MSA Kargo) in Operational Delivery, I gained practical exposure to operational data management, stock and distribution monitoring, delivery scheduling, shipment documentation, import-export administration, and customs clearance coordination. These experiences strengthened my ability to work with operational data, maintain document accuracy, monitor processes, and coordinate with different parties to support reliable logistics activities.

I also designed and implemented a web-based Air Waybill (AWB) management and validation system using PHP/Laravel to address document input errors in the operational process. The project reduced the recorded document error rate from 15.7% to 0% and shortened processing time per document from 572 seconds to 10.4 seconds. I enjoy identifying process-improvement opportunities and applying practical digital solutions to improve accuracy and operational efficiency. I am eager to contribute, continue learning, and grow in a professional logistics or supply chain environment.

On site

Final internship report

AWB validation system

A web application I built for MSA Kargo to stop input errors before PIB data goes into CEISA 4.0. I developed it with the Prototype method over two PDCA cycles and tested it with 31 Black Box test cases.

  • Three-step AWB input, with automatic checks on the AWB number, PIB NOPEN, PIB AJU and invoice fields.
  • Duplicate AWB detection, and consignee data paired automatically from a master list.
  • Document scan: OCR reads a photo of the PIB document and fills the form. The user checks the result, because OCR can misread look-alike characters (O/0, 1/I, 5/S).
  • Transaction recap with CSV, Excel and PDF export, and print per AWB.
  • Admin and Operator roles. Only Admin manages consignees and users.
  • Dashboard with a monthly transaction chart.
